hook: You spend your nights together and talk until sunrise. Yet whenever you bring up the future — he smiles: "Why ruin things with labels?"
body:
"Let's just enjoy the moment" sounds romantic, but in reality, it keeps you suspended in emotional limbo. You offer full-time devotion, loyalty, and care while remaining an unconfirmed footnote in his schedule.

It is rarely about past heartbreak. It is a calculated grey zone: enjoying 100% of relationship privileges while carrying 0% responsibility for your peace of mind.

A man who chooses you will never keep you guessing where you stand. Defining the relationship isn't a cage—it's basic respect for your time and heart.
